0022600176.text: The Brooklyn Nets (1-6, 15th in the East) host the Charlotte Hornets (3-5, 9th in the East) in their eighth game of the season, with Brooklyn already 0-3 at home and having lost its last game. Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain) are out for Brooklyn, while Charlotte is missing Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel (both hamstring), and Coby White is day-to-day with a calf issue. The Nets trail the season series 0-1 after losing 110-103 in Brooklyn on October 21, 2026, and they lost 1-2 to Charlotte in the 2025-26 season.
